description: Claude bot PR review findings — per-PR summaries. Append one entry per merged PR.

queries.category_trend: jq '[.reviews[] | .by_category | to_entries[]] | group_by(.key) | map({category: .[0].key, total: (map(.value) | add)})'
queries.most_flagged_files: jq '[.reviews[] | .flagged_files | to_entries[]] | group_by(.key) | map({file: .[0].key, total: (map(.value) | add)}) | sort_by(-.total)'
queries.severity_distribution: jq '[.reviews[] | .by_severity | to_entries[]] | group_by(.key) | map({severity: .[0].key, total: (map(.value) | add)})'

reviews.title: UI component library with full codebase migration
reviews.notes: Migration PR. Hit rate declined: R1-7 95%, R8 57%, R9 50%. Bot repeatedly flags already-fixed focus ring tokens (3x). Diminishing returns reached.
